# Pipeline upstream reference vectors

Pinned source and host conventions are described in
[`lc-raw/tests/fixtures/README.md`](../../../lc-raw/tests/fixtures/README.md).
Darktable `733bd69f32cac7ff5e41025115942772add1f088`; GPL-3.0-or-later.
All fixture files use little-endian IEEE floating point, not native structs.

* `capture-rl/estimate.f32`: 64x64 luminance, eight complete RL iterations; per-pixel sigma
  0.30/0.70/1.50, zero blend locations, including borders. Extracted `_blur_div`/`_blur_mul` and
  kernel generation. Tight absolute tolerance 3e-6 covers symmetric vs sequential summation.
* `negative/pixels.f32`: 256 RGB transmissions including zero, negatives, near-black and HDR;
  upstream `_process_pixel`, non-neutral WB/offset, print grade and shoulder. Tolerance 1e-6.
* `colorcal/lms.f32`: 256 triples each for linear/nonlinear Bradford, CAT16 and XYZ D65
  adaptation, including negative blue. Identity host colour matrices isolate the ported adaptation
  from working-space definitions. Tolerance 5e-7. Existing colour-calibration tests cover the
  Rec.2020 matrix conversions and neutral preservation.
* `toneeq/solve.f64`: three 9x8 interpolation matrices, RHS vectors and eight coefficients,
  using sigmas 0.7, sqrt(2), 2; upstream double Gaussian elimination. Tolerance 2e-8 on coefficients.
* `toneeq/gain.f32`: 513 corrections per solve across -8..0 EV; tolerance 2e-6 when coefficients
  are the same. The complete Rust curve uses a double-precision matrix and interpolated 256/EV
  LUT: separately measured tolerance 6e-5; its maximum discrepancy at sigma 2 is 4.4584e-5.

Save the following recipe to `target/refvec/pipeline-build.py`. First save the common
`target/refvec/raw-build.py` recipe from the raw README. No pycparser is needed for regeneration.
Run from the repository root, offline:

```sh
mkdir -p target/refvec/{negative,colorcal,toneeq}
mkdir -p crates/lc-pipeline/tests/fixtures/{negative,colorcal,toneeq}
python3 target/refvec/pipeline-build.py
for name in negative colorcal toneeq; do
  gcc -O2 -ffp-contract=off target/refvec/$name/reference.c -lm -o target/refvec/$name/reference
  target/refvec/$name/reference
done
# capture-rl is generated by raw-build.py; follow its README steps as well.
PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo +1.98.1 test --offline -p lightcraft-pipeline --lib refvec -- --nocapture
```

## `target/refvec/pipeline-build.py`

```python
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('/home/zdavidson/.local/share/local-image-dev/engine-sources/dt/src')
# Import the C numeric shim without executing other builds.
s=Path('target/refvec/raw-build.py').read_text();exec(s[:s.index('def write(')])
shim+='''\n#define __DT_CLONE_TARGETS__
#define THRESHOLD 2.3283064365386963e-10f
#define dt_alloc_align_double(n) ((double*)calloc(n,sizeof(double)))
#define dt_vector_log2(i,o) for(int c=0;c<4;c++)o[c]=log2f(i[c])
#define dt_vector_exp10(i,o) for(int c=0;c<4;c++)o[c]=powf(10.f,i[c])
#define dt_vector_powf(i,p,o) for(int c=0;c<4;c++)o[c]=powf(i[c],p[c])
#define dt_vector_exp(i,o) for(int c=0;c<4;c++)o[c]=expf(i[c])
static float fast_clamp(float a,float b,float c){return CLAMPF(a,b,c);}
'''
def write(name,body,main):Path('target/refvec/'+name+'/reference.c').write_text(shim+body+main)
neg=(root/'iop/negadoctor.c').read_text();neg=neg[neg.index('static inline void _process_pixel'):neg.index('void process(')]
main=r'''
int main(){float dm[4]={.7,.5,.3,1},wh[4]={1.1f/2.f,.9f/2.f,1.2f/2.f,1},off[4]={1.1f*.03f*.95f,.9f*.03f*1.02f,1.2f*.03f*1.1f,0};float b[4],e[4],g[4],s[4],sc[4];for(int c=0;c<4;c++){b[c]=-1.2f*(1.f-.08f);e[c]=1.2f;g[c]=1.6f;s[c]=.8f;sc[c]=1.f-.8f;}
FILE*fp=fopen("crates/lc-pipeline/tests/fixtures/negative/pixels.f32","wb");for(int i=0;i<256;i++){float in[4]={noise(i*3),noise(i*3+1),noise(i*3+2),0},out[4];if(i<4)for(int c=0;c<3;c++)in[c]=i==0?0.f:i==1?-1.f:i==2?1e-12f:4.f;_process_pixel(in,out,dm,wh,off,b,e,g,s,sc);fwrite(out,4,3,fp);}fclose(fp);}
'''
write('negative',neg,main)
ch=(root/'common/chromatic_adaptation.h').read_text()
def function(src,start):
 a=src.index(start);b=src.index('{',a);depth=1;i=b+1
 while depth:
  depth+=(src[i]=='{')-(src[i]=='}');i+=1
 return src[a:i]+'\n'
body=''.join(function(ch,n) for n in ['static inline void bradford_adapt_D65','static inline void CAT16_adapt_D65','static inline void XYZ_adapt_D65'])
main=r'''
int main(){float src[4]={.7f,1.f,1.3f,0};float p=powf(src[2]/1.088932f,.0834f);FILE*fp=fopen("crates/lc-pipeline/tests/fixtures/colorcal/lms.f32","wb");
for(int mode=0;mode<4;mode++)for(int i=0;i<256;i++){float in[4]={-1.f+3.f*noise(i*2),1.f,-1.f+3.f*noise(i*2+1),0},out[4];if(mode<2)bradford_adapt_D65(in,src,p,mode==1,out);else if(mode==2)CAT16_adapt_D65(in,src,1.f,1,out);else XYZ_adapt_D65(in,src,out);fwrite(out,4,3,fp);}fclose(fp);}
'''
write('colorcal',body,main)
tone=(root/'iop/toneequal.c').read_text();elim=(root/'iop/gaussian_elimination.h').read_text();elim=re.sub(r'^#.*$','',elim,flags=re.M)
body='''#include <assert.h>
#define CHANNELS 9
#define PIXEL_CHAN 8
#define DT_TONEEQ_MIN_EV -8.f
#define DT_TONEEQ_MAX_EV 0.f
#define DT_ALIGNED_ARRAY
'''+tone[tone.index('static const float centers_ops'):tone.index('typedef struct dt_iop_toneequalizer_params_t')]
# Only numeric constants, not UI structs.
body=body[:body.index('typedef enum')] if 'typedef enum' in body else body
body+=function(tone,'static float gaussian_denom')+function(tone,'static float gaussian_func')+function(tone,'static inline float pixel_correction')+function(tone,'static inline void build_interpolation_matrix')+elim
main=r'''
int main(){const float zones[9]={.2f,-.1f,.3f,.5f,.8f,.4f,-.3f,-.2f,.1f};FILE*fp=fopen("crates/lc-pipeline/tests/fixtures/toneeq/solve.f64","wb");FILE*fg=fopen("crates/lc-pipeline/tests/fixtures/toneeq/gain.f32","wb");
for(int mode=0;mode<3;mode++){float sigma=mode==0?.7f:mode==1?sqrtf(2.f):2.f;float a[72];build_interpolation_matrix(a,sigma);double ad[72],y[9];for(int i=0;i<72;i++)ad[i]=a[i];for(int i=0;i<9;i++)y[i]=exp2f(zones[i]);fwrite(ad,8,72,fp);double input[9];memcpy(input,y,sizeof(input));fwrite(input,8,9,fp);pseudo_solve_gaussian(ad,y,9,8,1);fwrite(y,8,8,fp);float factors[8];for(int i=0;i<8;i++)factors[i]=y[i];for(int i=0;i<=512;i++){float v=pixel_correction(-8.f+i/64.f,factors,sigma);fwrite(&v,4,1,fg);}}
fclose(fp);fclose(fg);}
'''
write('toneeq',body,main)
```
